evidence_class: Configured desktop Forward Mobile runtime stills plus isolated/native and 112px silhouette inspection. No canonical QA11, physical device, child or owner acceptance.
scoring_limit: 4.5 is a local candidate judgment for these seven still objects. Only the owner can accept shipped views at 5/5. It does not rate all retained art, game-wide backgrounds or motion.

dimensions.role_and_whole_silhouette: R-ROLE1/2, R-ID1, R-GEO1/2; named whole object and useful landmarks at 112px
dimensions.identity_and_motif: R-ID2/3/4, R-MOT1/3/4; declared Mermaid Roshan motifs without extra characters or unrelated scene pieces
dimensions.material_and_palette: R-MAT1/2; distinguish materials while fitting the room and existing cast
dimensions.alpha_and_support: R-GOV1, R-GEO3/5, R-QA2; clean isolated boundary and appropriate whole support/attachment
dimensions.runtime_composition: R-REP1/3, R-FUNC2/3; readable driving distance and split views, road clear of props
